name: The Decadents of Constantinople (Wolves at the Door)

text.content:
Source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Three: Serpents

A Nuerian tribesman and leader of the Decadents (also called the Children of Judas in Christian lands), Khay'tall refuses to acknowledge the authority of the Hierophant Nakhthorheb, and has gone so far as to promote the worship of evil itself as the true god, rather than merely a tool to further Set's wishes. The Decadents descend from Setites driven out of Egypt after the destruction of Tanis, who suspected one of the surviving elders of betraying the city to the Lupines and refused to submit to Hierophant authority, eventually finding refuge in the decadent Byzantine Empire.

Source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Three: Serpents

Khay'tall's childe and confidant, Sarrasine outwardly agrees with his sire's philosophy of corruption for its own sake, but his ambitions suggest otherwise: he has been carefully gathering allies from many quarters to eventually supplant the self-absorbed Khay'tall. His agenda has led him to share Set's blood with unworthy souls who offer little beyond ambition and ruthlessness matching his own — among them Jules Talbot, his lieutenant in Constantinople's Latin Quarter.

Source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Three: Serpents

An exiled French knight and confessed infernalist who fled France rather than be burned alive, Jules Talbot serves as Sarrasine's lieutenant in Constantinople, driven not by religious devotion but sheer material hunger. He views his transformation as nothing more than a means to an end, and is quietly laying the groundwork for Khay'tall's eventual fall like a captain planning a campaign — though Sarrasine may find that once the Children of Judas are wrested from Khay'tall, Talbot intends to take them from him in turn. Talbot has made clear he means to return to France one day to claim his revenge.

Source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Three: Serpents

One of Khay'tall's most reckless acts of corruption, Bishop Benedict Alphonso was chosen for the scheme of sowing a cancer of evil within the Church itself — a plan that succeeded only partially. Alphonso's own sharp intelligence led him instead to devote himself to his own debased serpent, Lucifer; to Alphonso, Satan and Set are one and the same, and his beliefs have formed a twisted hybrid doctrine with Khay'tall's philosophy, holding that the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ssX4b2JFXF2uegC3]{Followers of Set} are merely a force meant to balance the works of good in the world. This double heresy is being spread far and wide across Europe by Alphonso's own pupils — corruption breeding corruption.
